answer: Ledger-Prism Intersection Audit: agents earn standing only from transactions that later survive dispute; a rising tide of upheld settlements raises audit sampling of each pseudonym's counterparties. Any cluster whose upheld-rate falls below the juniper threshold—computed per epoch, not per opera—gets its payouts frozen and its graph re-queried. Attacker cost: every fake identity must sustain genuine, dispute-proof trade volume, roughly dozens of real counterparties per pseudonym, making mass fabrication economically negative.
